title: Batch 77 · App, agent and design-panel concepts
note: Concepts Area lacked, found by reading the icons Cursor (its cursor-icons registry and codicon additions) and the Claude desktop app (its 395-glyph set) use in sidebars, settings, agent panels and pickers, plus Area's own IA after PR #191: AI review and suggestion marks, task status, a non-git split for Explorations, a floating panel, two Figma design-panel effects, Motion for Foundations, and five picker icons. Drawn on the 2026-11-01 rules (gap floor one line, less round corners). Dropped: agents (two agent figures; the offset back copy read as a padlock at 16) and mailbox (the flag read as a corner mark; mail and inbox cover the use).

icons.name: search-sparkle
icons.label: AI search
icons.spec: circle; search's r 5 lens and its 10.75→14 handle with chat-sparkle's ±3 family sparkle moved to 11, 5; the lens overlap-cut round the sparkle (behind, 2.25) from 8.619, 2.269 round the left to 10.536, 10.536 where the handle starts; sparkle to handle 1.64 tight, counter 1.51; filled: the sparkle solid, lens and handle lines.

icons.label: AI suggestion
